The system operates in continuous wave mode, where the communication and ranging functions are executed with the same signal. The PRN code is used to spread spectrum the communication data, and the phase of the subcarrier signal is used to measure the distance to the target. The system uses a correlation operation to extract the codeword synchronization positions of the echo and local signals, and then uses a phase-shift measurement to derive the distance to the target.
